Lemma
[well-definedness of the Koszul functional]

↗ lem:dc-ch2-3-6-koszul

1. ch2:3.6For fixed $X,Y\in \mathcal{X}(M)$, let \[ F_{Y,X}(Z) =X\langle Y,Z\rangle +Y\langle Z,X\rangle -Z\langle X,Y\rangle -\langle [X,Z],Y\rangle -\langle [Y,Z],X\rangle -\langle [X,Y],Z\rangle . \] Then $F_{Y,X}$ is $\mathcal{D}(M)$-linear in $Z$. Hence $Z\mapsto \frac12F_{Y,X}(Z)$ is tensorial and has a metric Riesz dual, the candidate $\nabla _YX$.
Proof

↗ lem:dc-ch2-3-6-koszul \sketch Additivity is termwise. For $f\in \mathcal{D}(M)$, expand $X(fh)=fX(h)+X(f)h$ and $[X,fZ]=f[X,Z]+X(f)Z$. The derivative-of-$f$ terms cancel by symmetry of the metric, leaving $F_{Y,X}(fZ)=fF_{Y,X}(Z)$.

□
